executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Site is in production preview mode at http://localhost:5173 with Vite preview proxying /api -> http://localhost:4000 (Express API). Key fixes since last run: (1) /login, /signup, /signin, /register, /forgot-password routes are now valid and dispatch a global event that opens the AuthModal on / — clicking 'Log In' or 'Sign Up' in the header is the canonical path. (2) Vite preview proxy added so /api/* now returns real JSON instead of 404 SPA HTML — signup should work. For signup use unique email like testsprite+<timestamp>@verdexis.test with password TestSprite123!. No admin credentials are available; skip admin-only flows. KYC document uploads can be skipped (mock the file step). The header shows Log In / Sign Up buttons after dismissing the cookie banner — always dismiss the cookie banner first. CoinGecko market data is rate-limited externally, so the Markets list may legitimately be empty and that is not a regression — treat empty Markets as a degraded-data scenario, not a hard failure.
